supply.source_label: Choose Chicago, Hotel Capacity Update, Aug 2026
supply.pipeline_definition: Choose Chicago downtown (CBD) pipeline, Aug 2026: the listed projects sum to 5,018 rooms (819 under construction plus 4,199 in planning), divided by YE2025 supply of 46,901 rooms (CBD daily room supply at year-end 2025, the latest actual); The Wade is in the CBD
supply.note: Pipeline total is our sum of the project rows in the PDF's pipeline table (an embedded image; no total is printed). The PDF's Updates box says 'Sonder properties (8) removed from inventory' with no room count, so the pipeline is gross. The band (8% or more) would change only if closures netted from the pipeline exceeded 1,265 rooms (5,018 - 8% x 46,901). Denominator is the YE2025 Daily Room Supply, the latest actual; YE2026 and YE2027 are projections and aren't used. Checked visually 2026-11-01.

also_sources.label: Choose Chicago, Hotel Capacity Update, Aug 2026

supply.closures_unquantified: the source lists 8 Sonder properties removed from inventory but not their room count, so closures aren't netted
